component: Exchange folder and operation-listener interface rename

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The IEwsFolder rename also changes IEwsFolderOperationListener in the same IDL file. The folder and listener keep their separate UUIDs, method signatures and parameter order. The owned C++ callers update interface types, inheritance, support macros and generated method declarations together; build input changes to IExchangeFolder.idl. Existing completion and undo responsibilities remain at the actual callers. This is a checked source-level rename, not a compiled ABI guarantee. Remaining intra-EWS wording and the EwsFetchMsgsToOffline prose reference are not proof that every implementation or comment name was migrated.
title: The folder rename updates both generated interface names
